Ir.bar_b_note: A grounded, textured naturalistic newt with gold frills, but the dark grey-black reticulated back sinks into a mid-dark value block with no rim light, so it lacks Palworld's colour pop and readable values.

Ve.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with expressive eyes, a strong white-hair silhouette and an earthy green-brown palette that matches the key art; it is shown only on a void, so the world fit is inferred.

Bv.bar_b_note: The model is solid and grounded, but in faint end the belly-up back reads almost black with small tan cells and no warm olive, so it falls short of Palworld's saturated finish.

So.bar_b_note: The fight is murky and brown under a large HUD, with flat magenta outline telegraphs, no purple storm sky and no lightning; A also puts the camera in canopy in several frames, so it reads nothing like Palworld's bright, legible boss fights.

Tj.bar_b_note: B's panel fits the deep blue-grey, pale-border, gold-text direction and reads at a glance, but its glyphs are small and the dull, dark world behind it sinks the shot next to Palworld.

Fl.bar_b_note: Stormcapra matches the owner style bar when standing (white fleece, brown curled horns, blue accents), but on A the faint poses float with an open grey underside, and the void stage gives no atmosphere.

Ba.bar_b_note: The creature is well modelled and grounded, and the swim pose reads, but the sooty dark-grey back with no rim light keeps it below Palworld-level colour and value separation.

Xn.bar_b_note: The silhouette and frills read, but the near-black faint-end back and the low-saturation grey-umber body sit far from Palworld's bright, rim-lit creatures.

top_changes.change: Re-grade the newt/axolotl creature's albedo (Ir/Bv/Ba/Xn): a warm olive-umber back and flanks with lighter, larger markings, a lifted mid-value, and a rim/fresnel term so the body separates from the stage and stays readable belly-up in faint end.

Stormwood fight (So): replace the flat magenta outline telegraphs with real-object VFX (lightning strands, web or stone impacts), shrink and translucent-ise the left and bottom HUD blocks, add the fixed purple storm sky and white-violet lightning grade, and keep the camera out of trunks and canopy so the player's creature is visible.
Stormcapra faint (Fl A path): snap the faint-mid and faint-end poses to the stage so the shadow touches the body, and close or texture the grey open underside that shows when it rolls.
